title: 18282 - 18282/P1874/006260
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Valve for Torque Support Mount faulty
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Valve for Torque Support Mount faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Valve for Torque Support Mount
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connectors from/to Valve for Torque Support Mount
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Audi A8 (4E): 3.7l/4.2l/4.0l TDI or 6.0l Engine, Kontrol edin: TPL/TSB 2006451.
Due to changes in the Production Process the Valve may not be used anymore and requires further steps.
For the NAR market 2005-2007 A8 4.2L vehicles refer to TSB # 10-08-04 -or- TPI # 2010270/6 or newer publications.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
